owner_snapshot_semantics: Owner hashes, dispositions and read_only_diagnostics describe source_commit, before the separately authorized numerical corrections. Compare these hashes to that immutable baseline, not a later working tree.

implementation_follow_up.scope: Basic/composed supported slab distribution checks and composed solid-slab maximum shear only; cumulative qualification HOLDs remain.

coverage_semantics: Resolve default and override disposition IDs through disposition_definitions. Expand caller_set through caller_sets. Disjoint explicit overrides take precedence; every remaining caller receives default. All38 frozen callers receive exactly one disposition. This is a source/caller reconciliation, not a PASS for unknown or excluded cases.
row_definition: One source instruction block, including every numbered subtarget, not one row per visual line.

D001.rationale: Self-compacting and fibre-specific mixture guidance is outside the ordinary RC structural mechanics family; the caller does not select or certify these products.
D001.applicability_boundary: No SCC/fibre constitutive, fresh-property or material eligibility claim.

D002.rationale: These two owners consume supplied loads, dimensions and externally approved soil pressure; they calculate bearing/sizing without RC strength, reinforcement, material production or construction acceptance.
D002.applicability_boundary: No soil-capacity, settlement or material certification is inferred.

D003.rationale: The supplied fck/fy values and representative material law do not encode cement, admixture, aggregate, water, coating, supplier qualification or physical material eligibility. An approved ordinary RC input is a prerequisite; the amendment cannot be declared satisfied from numeric range checks.
D003.applicability_boundary: No material-family or actual concrete-product qualification. Retain exact profiles IS456_FIG23_REP_GS115_V1 and IS456_ANNEX_C_RECT_SINGLE_V1.

D004.rationale: The generic bond helper distinguishes plain/deformed bars without a coating input. The selected callers do not establish an epoxy-coated supported material domain or prove coated-bar bond reduction. Amendment6 supersedes the earlier Amendment4 table-value basis.
D004.applicability_boundary: Retain an uncoated assumption where explicitly declared; a new coated route requires explicit source/contract/benchmark scope.

D005.rationale: The combined and strap supported cases explicitly exclude coated bars, so this coated-bond rule is outside their declared domain.
D005.applicability_boundary: Existing uncoated-only qualification remains bounded; no coating implementation inferred.

D006.rationale: The frozen callers design/check supplied structural cases and actions. They do not select concrete mixes, control batching/curing, release formwork, sample/test site concrete, assess existing-concrete acceptance or certify construction/fire processes.
D006.applicability_boundary: These remain external project prerequisites; this disposition does not certify material eligibility or construction acceptance.

D007.rationale: The changed target belongs to a different stated member or method. The caller retains its declared case and governing owners; it does not implement the changed rule for that other case.
D007.applicability_boundary: Only the changed target is disposed; all shared material and edition HOLDs remain.

D008.rationale: Practical bar placement/compaction and congestion require project geometry and execution evidence. Numeric steel-area checks alone do not certify these added recommendations.
D008.applicability_boundary: Bundles, construction approval and material/bar selection are outside several promoted cases; complete family-specific congestion coverage is not established.

D009.rationale: Canonical beam validates its discrete diameter set through32mm; the advanced detailing owner also restricts selected longitudinal diameters to STANDARD_BAR_DIAMETERS ending at32mm and rejects36mm. Neither traced promoted generator produces a lap above32mm.
D009.applicability_boundary: Direct low-level lap helper accepts36mm, but that alone is not a supported beam-generator outcome or a new mechanical-splice claim.

D010.rationale: The amended distribution limit is min(5d,300mm); these owners retain min(5d,450mm). The independent diagnostic with d125mm and distribution14@400mm returns detailing_is_adequate=True instead of failing the amended spacing check.
D010.applicability_boundary: Demonstrated through complete simply-supported one-way service; shared continuous/two-way distribution owners also retain450mm. No complete engineering approval is claimed.

D011.rationale: The straight-flight staircase owner retains a450mm distribution cap. It requires a staircase-specific outcome replay and interpretation before closing discrepancy/conformance.
D011.applicability_boundary: One solid longitudinal waist slab; no extrapolation to other stair forms.

D012.rationale: The regular-interior flat-slab owner checks reinforcement as main bars using the shared300mm cap, plus its own flat-slab spacing checks; the amended distribution450mm path is not selected.
D012.applicability_boundary: Regular interior main-reinforcement directions only; no general flat-slab qualification.

D013.rationale: Footing owners cite slab spacing provisions; their exact main/distribution direction classification and caller outcomes require a separate owner trace.
D013.applicability_boundary: No foundation-spacing discrepancy is asserted from a shared reference alone.

D014.rationale: The beam placement/compaction note requires a member-by-member applicability trace. Torsion composes beam flexure and strap includes a rectangular beam, so their family names cannot justify a different-member dismissal. The remaining untraced bindings stay unresolved.
D014.applicability_boundary: A numeric ultimate capacity or steel ratio does not certify bar placement; no new numerical limit is inferred.

D015.rationale: The amendment adds a practical placement/compaction caution at4% steel. A computed ultimate strength or maximum ratio does not establish its site-placement prerequisite.
D015.applicability_boundary: Do not replace the existing numerical limit or certify placement from this advisory note.

D016.rationale: The side-face reinforcement owner already cites and applies29.3.4 with32.5; the accepted deep-beam ledger explicitly records Amendment3.
D016.applicability_boundary: Simply-supported deep-beam case only; accepted numerical correction is reused unchanged.

D017.rationale: The column contract and service permit fck up to80N/mm2, while Table2 Note2 requires separate substantiation aboveM60. The source/caller mapping does not supply that substantiation; helper acceptance is not material qualification.
D017.applicability_boundary: Representative formulas and bounded section benchmarks do not qualify every high-strength concrete product or design property.

D018.rationale: The corrected panel-moment reference applies when moment redistribution is used. The maintained coefficient routes explicitly require redistribution=False.
D018.applicability_boundary: Tables12/13/26/27 supported coefficient cases remain unchanged; no redistribution extension.

D019.rationale: The added bond allowance is for nominal reinforcement in M15 plain concrete. The frozen structural routes are reinforced-concrete design/check cases; ordinary RC design bond is a separate rule.
D019.applicability_boundary: Do not apply the plain-concrete nominal allowance to reinforced-concrete development length.

D020.rationale: Clause35.3.2 is a general crack limit. The absence of a traced crack-width result in a member workflow does not prove that the exposure requirement belongs to a different member; its actual binding or held-case boundary remains unverified.
D020.applicability_boundary: No direct crack-width or exposure qualification is inferred for these untraced callers.

D021.rationale: The canonical beam serviceability contract already limits VERY_SEVERE and EXTREME exposure to0.1mm. The selected explicit Level-A beam crack route uses that contract.
D021.applicability_boundary: Only canonical beam with explicit crack inputs; finite history and direct long-term qualification remain held.

D022.rationale: Slab direct crack width is explicitly held; a span/depth carrier or supplied review acknowledgement does not implement the amended crack rule.
D022.applicability_boundary: No slab direct deflection or crack-width qualification.

D023.rationale: The declared wall, deep-beam and regular-interior flat-slab cases explicitly exclude direct crack-width checks. They do not certify the amended exposure limit.
D023.applicability_boundary: This is a held workflow boundary, not a claim that the general material crack requirement is irrelevant.

D024.rationale: The flanged service advertises explicit serviceability, but its exact exposure-limit binding needs a separate contract trace before reusing the canonical verdict.
D024.applicability_boundary: Monolithic sagging T-beam, explicit SLS inputs only.

D025.rationale: BasePDF75/printed74 identifies40.5.2 as total shear reinforcement for sections close to supports, not a bent-up-bar rule. The current owner computes vertical-stirrup spacing and optionally enhanced concrete shear; its exact accumulated reinforcement and near-support caller binding are not qualified here.
D025.applicability_boundary: Retain the sumAsv source correction; no discrepancy or complete near-support conformance is inferred from a single-stirrup area or family name.

D026.rationale: These changes belong to working-stress modular ratio/permissible stresses. The selected mechanics use limit-state and explicitly selected elastic serviceability material laws, not a working-stress design workflow.
D026.applicability_boundary: Table21 working-stress bond must not be substituted forCl26.2.1.1 design bond. Existing helper provenance wording is not an independent WSM authority.

D027.rationale: The correction identifies the AnnexE effective-length nomogram figure. The frozen column callers accept supplied effective lengths or their declared end-condition model; this packet does not certify an AnnexE nomogram derivation.

D028.rationale: This rule qualifies mechanical couplers toIS16172. The frozen callers do not certify coupler products or mechanical-splice design.
D028.applicability_boundary: Existing lap/anchorage output is not mechanical-coupler qualification.

D029.rationale: The solid-slab owner obtains the full Table20 maximum instead of half. Independent M20 case: tau_v=2N/mm2; required cap1.4 versus actual2.8 changes exceeds_maximum_shear_stress to increase_depth_or_engineer_reinforcement.
D029.applicability_boundary: UDL solid beam/wall-supported slab only; actual safe_without_reinforcement remainsFalse, so this is a limit/classification discrepancy, not a demonstrated unsafe overall PASS.

D030.rationale: This solid-slab limit may be relevant to this solid slab-like member, but its actual shear owner/case mapping needs separate interpretation and outcome evidence.
D030.applicability_boundary: Do not halve shared Table20 globally or change beam, torsion or foundation rules by proximity.

D031.rationale: The exact solid-slab interpretation, one-way/punching operation and any external verification boundary of foundation members need a source/caller trace. A foundation family label alone cannot dismiss the amended maximum-shear rule.
D031.applicability_boundary: No global Table20 change or confirmed foundation defect is inferred; primitive checks do not certify a complete foundation shear limit.

D032.rationale: The composed torsion owner already derives both equivalent bending moments and designs the corresponding longitudinal reinforcement under41.4.2 as part of the equivalent-shear workflow.
D032.applicability_boundary: Solid rectangular singly-reinforced face composition; no torsion redistribution, flanged or coupled doubly-reinforced extension.
